text: The blood glucose, thyroid function, and CT head scan are all within normal limits, so the cause of your mental status changes isn't in those areas. Have you been experiencing any recent severe headache, neck stiffness, or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of hypertension and significant smoking, and the exclusion of metabolic, thyroid, and structural causes, have you noticed any vision changes, difficulty speaking, or one-sided weakness lately? Also, how would you describe the nature of these mental status changes—sudden onset or gradual?

text: Denies headache, seizure, vision changes, chest pain, dyspnea, nausea, vomiting, recent illness, or fever.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the clarification; you have no headache, vision changes, or other focal neurological deficits. To further investigate the cause of your confusion and lethargy, I need to know if you have noticed any recent falls or trauma to your head, and whether you have been taking your hypertension medication regularly.
